runes.canvas: single isometric ellipse; game rotates continuously and layers three rune rings from the painted asset

sequence.visual: rune circles form and rotate around the traveler
light column descends until its foot touches the ground
traveler lifts and dissolves while the source circles remain
the destination beam touches down before the traveler is revealed
the traveler appears only after the destination beam touches the ground
beam retracts; runes break into drifting pixels after the traveler appears

animation_sampling.method: alpha-aware midpoint blend between adjacent official PNG frames; the last frame is held for the second sample
animation_sampling.sync: server timestamps, transfer/apex markers, and audio duration remain on the original 2700 ms timeline
